found.name: Academic Integrity Fundamentals course
found.quote: The Academic Integrity Fundamentals course, available to all UCC students in the Canvas Success Zone contains a module on the responsible use of GenAI that can help introduce students to critical AI literacy and GenAI in the context of academic integrity. It is recommended that all students engage with this course
